description: Land Acquisition - Bulugohothenna, Akurana D/S Division, Kandy District - Correction Notice to the Gaz. No. 1988/6 of 10/10/2016 and Gaz. No. 2236/39 of 14.07.2021
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (Palliyagawawatta) with descriptions of the land, claimants, boundaries, and compensation procedures. It also includes a corrigenda section correcting land extent measurements. The content focuses exclusively on land and property matters, fitting the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "land registrations, property ownership, land titles."
